title: Other pianists she heard and being chaperoned
summary: She recalls pianist Walter Decou, and says she was always chaperoned by her uncle, brothers and sons.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Well, they didn't have very many piano plays at that time. I do remember Walter Deku.

Oh, yes. He's still living, too. We've never interviewed him. Yeah. He's hard to find. He doesn't play anymore. He gave up music. He had some mental trouble, too, I think, you know, for a while, too. Oh, I see.
But he was popular at the time that I was popular.
I heard he play, too. He made some records with the Bunk Johnson, the trumpet, the famous trumpet player who he knew quite well. He's dead now, too. Any other pianists that you heard?
I guess I heard a gang of them,
but I tried to remember. It's hard to remember all those. I tried to remember. Did you get out much? I know a lot of times girls don't get out much, you know, to go around to hear music like Boa.
Well, I got out because I was with my uncle.
That's why I always had someone with me. Yes. See, when I left my uncle, I went with my brothers, and they were with my sons.
